original:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
a = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]
window = sum(a[:k])
best = window
for i in range(1, n - k):
    window += a[i + k - 1] - a[i - 1]
    best = max(best, window)
print(best)
